mission.title: Redpill Rescue
mission.description: Rescue a Zion team from Machine attackers.

phase.briefing: One of our teams reports that they are under attack by Machine operatives. This was supposed to have ended with the Truce. Hurry to the indicated location and get our people out!

enter.say: Now that you are inside, there are a few things we need out of you. First, eliminate the attackers that have our people pinned down. When you've killed them, search their bodies for any suspicious objects that might shed more light on this. After that you'll be extracting the Zion operatives. The three that you are looking for are Duboshin, Altaj, and Tolosa. Once you've located them, get them out of the hot zone and lead them to a hardline so they can jack out. Do not let any of them die!

talk.say: I'm so glad you've made it here. Those bastards locked us up and put some sort of field around the key. We couldn't hack our way out.
We'll follow you out of here.
I want them to pay for this!
I can heal you if things get bad.

done.say: All programs have been eliminated. These are some of the weakest Agents I've ever seen. Something bigger must be going on here.

objective.text: Search the attackers' bodies for suspicious objects

done.say: We'll need to take a look at that after the mission is over.

objective.text: Lead Duboshin, Altaj and Tolosa out of the hot zone

done.say: You're out. Now lead them to a hardline.

objective.text: Lead Duboshin, Altaj and Tolosa to a hardline
Do not let any of them die

mission.finish: I'm sorry to put you through that, {player}. We need to find out why the Agents attacked our men. The Truce is still in effect... Why would they do this?
